§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: This is my favorite site, I know everything about the great §5Dragons§f.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: This is of course §5Jythar§f, the Eternal One.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: The dragon army attacked our dimension many centuries ago and sent the world into pieces.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: The skeleton of §5Chozon§f can be seen on the island south of here. He was one of the generals of Jythar.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: Dogen, Kirva, and Daydro perished and fell in the void, to my knowledge.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: The 4 generals were so huge that their reach could cover the sun and bring shadows upon entire cities.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: Thousands of Dragons attacked that day and all were defeated, but did they fail?
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: What even was their purpose?
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: I think they decided to break the world to weaken us, and by us I mean everyone in this dimension.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: Despite the wars raging at the time, we were still able to unite and beat this common enemy.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: Jythar knew there would be no path to victory against us for as long as we could unite.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: But why not retreat?
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: Why did he keep attacking us until his death?
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: I doubt it was madness. Dragons live for millennia, their Emperor surely wasn't mad.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: So why would he give up his life to guarantee a potential victory in the future?
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: It's impossible for us to know, but we can theorize.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: It is known from the Dragons summoned nowadays that they worship their §5Queen§f.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: Queen, Empress - the exact word might have been lost in translation.
§e[NPC] §dCorm§f: I think Jythar did it for her.

'''Tasty Mithril''' is an {{Uncommon}} item that can be obtained during the [[Dwarven Mines#Mithril Gourmand|Mithril Gourmand]] event.

== Obtaining ==
'''Tasty Mithril''' has a {{Green|30%}} chance to drop from [[Mithril|Mithril Ore]] during the [[Dwarven Mines#Mithril Gourmand|Mithril Gourmand]] event in specific areas of the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}}. The area that players need to mine in is announced at the beginning of the event and is displayed in the sidebar.

== Usage ==
'''Tasty Mithril''' can be fed to {{NPC|Don Expresso}} during the [[Dwarven Mines#Mithril Gourmand|Mithril Gourmand]] event. Doing so will grant various rewards to the player.


== Trivia ==
* Feeding {{NPC|Don Expresso}} '''Tasty Mithril''' for the first time will reward the player with the {{ach|A Good Review|ach=true}}.
* If {{NPC|Don Expresso}} is fed '''Tasty Mithril''' from a previous event, it will be wiped from the player's inventory without counting toward the event, with the following dialogue:
